# Your insurance denied the claim. Here is the appeal, the deadline and what to attach.

> Free tool for patients: paste your health insurance denial letter and get the likely denial reason, your appeal deadline, a draft appeal letter, a checklist of what to gather and calendar reminders. Runs in your browser, the letter is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
